title: Wan 2.7-Image (Pro)
summary: A professional image generation and editing tool from Alibaba's Tongyi Lab featuring 'Thinking Mode' for advanced semantic reasoning and multi-reference face control. It supports 4K resolution output and precise hex-code color management for high-end design workflows.
research_notes: Developed by Alibaba's Tongyi Lab; features a 9-grid multi-image input system to maintain character and style consistency across generations.

evolution.summary: The project transitioned from the open-source Wan 2.1/2.2 foundation to a commercial multimodal suite. Wan 2.7 introduced 'Thinking Mode' reasoning and split into specialized Image and Video branches, now competing with Sora 2 and Kling 2.6.
